item.title: Anthropic to challenge Pentagon supply chain risk designation in court - OnMSFT
item.description: Anthropic plans to challenge the Pentagon in court after the Defense Department labeled the AI firm a supply chain risk.

item.title: Amazon launches Connect Health to automate hospital admin work with AI - OnMSFT
item.description: Amazon launches Connect Health, an AI platform that automates scheduling, documentation, and patient verification for healthcare providers and clinics.

item.title: WhatsApp Testing New ‘WhatsApp Plus’ Premium Subscription - OnMSFT
item.description: WhatsApp may launch a WhatsApp Plus subscription offering custom themes, extra chat controls, exclusive stickers, and more personalization features for users.

item.title: X Tests New Ad Format That Recommends Products Under Posts - OnMSFT
item.description: X is testing recommendation ads that appear under posts mentioning products, starting with a Starlink example spotted by users in Europe.

item.title: Chrome’s GlowUp Design Brings Tab Strip Declutter, Tab Glow Effect, and Glass Toolbar - OnMSFT
item.description: Google is testing a new desktop interface in Chrome internally called “GlowUp.” This Chrome GlowUp design cleans up the tab strip and adds new visual…

item.title: Chrome's Projects Panel Will Show Gemini and AI Mode Activity - OnMSFT
item.description: Google is working on a Projects panel in Chrome that can show Gemini chats and AI Mode threads alongside tab groups, with quick access to conversation activity.

item.title: Microsoft, Google Say Claude Will Stay in Their Platforms Despite Pentagon Designation - OnMSFT
item.description: Microsoft and Google say Anthropic Claude stays available for non-defense use despite Pentagon restrictions, while AWS customers can also keep access.

item.title: Chrome for Android Prepares Gemini "Let Chrome Browse for You" Setting - OnMSFT
item.description: Chrome Canary for Android adds a Gemini setting called “Let Chrome browse for you,” which allows Gemini to work across tabs and complete tasks.

item.title: Original Xbox Emulator X1 BOX Arrives on Android - OnMSFT
item.description: Original Xbox emulator X1 BOX arrives on Android through an unofficial xemu port, but performance issues and setup requirements remain for now.

item.title: How Apple Made the $599 MacBook Neo Without Using Plastic - OnMSFT
item.description: Apple explains how the $599 MacBook Neo keeps its aluminum design, new manufacturing process, colorful design, and strong sustainability goals.
